pages.text: Health 150, Knockback Resistance 0.75, Attack 3, Speed 0.27.$(br)Can wear $(l)armor$().$(br)$(l)Arrows$(): damage = attack + 1; it only fires at full draw.$(br)75, Attack 3, Speed 0.27.$(br)$(l)Volley$(): leaps up and looses 24 arrows at once, each resolved as a normal arrow hit.

$(l)Bone Sweep$(): hits everything within 3 blocks in front for attack + 1, breaks shields for 40 ticks and knocks them back.$(br)$(l)Rib Crush$(): a point-blank target takes attack + 6, loses its shield for 100 ticks and is blasted away.$(br)$(l)Soul Jar$(): +25 health, +2 magic damage on arrows and melee, with soul particles on its arrows.

$(l)Hateful Bone Helm$(): draw wind-up x2/3, spread arrows x2 (24 becomes 48), a normal draw has a 35%% chance to become a triple shot, and those shots ignore invulnerability frames.$(br)75, Attack 3, Speed 0.27.$(br)Concentrated Bone Block (up to 5): each gives +10 health, +0.7 attack, +2 armor, +1 toughness.
$(l)Maxed$(): every arrow it fires gains one of Weakness, Poison (Venom if its owner wears the wilderness set) or Hunger for 5 seconds.
